perks.name: Tempest
perks.desc:
This memory unlocks all warrior disciplines for you. You gain the talent "Tempest" which raises your melee weapon damage for a short time.

Tier I: 15% increased weapon damage, 10 seconds duration (Cooldown: 110)
Tier II: 25% increased weapon damage, 12 seconds duration (Cooldown: 105)
Tier III: 35% increased weapon damage, 14 seconds duration (Cooldown: 100)

perks.name: Juggernaut
perks.desc:
The memories of the "Keeper" improve the effect of defensive techniques.

Tier I: Heavy armor and shields have 12% more armor
Tier II: Heavy armor and shields have another 11% more armor

perks.name: Shield Wall
perks.desc:
Tier I: Blocking is 12% more effective
Tier II: Blocking is another 11% more effective

perks.name: Splintet Limbs
perks.desc: If you are wearing solely heavy armor you take 80% decreased falling damage.

perks.name: Firm State
perks.desc: You can no longer be knocked down and the chance that enemy attacks stagger you is lowered.

perks.name: Arrow Wall
perks.desc: Blocking with a shield reduces incoming fire, frost, and shock damage by 30%.

perks.name: Tower of Strength
perks.desc:
Makes you nearly invulnerable for a short time against physical damage.

Tier I: 50% Damage Reduction, 12 Seconds (Cooldown: 130)
Tier II: 65% Damage Reduction, 12 Seconds (Cooldown: 130)
Tier III: 80% Damage Reduction, 12 Seconds (Cooldown: 130)

perks.name: Shield Stroke
perks.desc: A charged up bash with your shield has a chance to disarm your enemies.

perks.name: Shield Runner
perks.desc: You can move faster with a shield raised.

perks.name: Conditioning
perks.desc: Heavy Armor and Shields now slow you down less and weigh 30% less while equipped.

perks.name: Reflect Attack
perks.desc:
You have a small chance that you reflect taken melee damage back to your enemies.

Tier I: 5% chance to reflect melee damage
Tier II: Another 5% chance to reflect melee damage

perks.name: Iron Will
perks.desc: Increases your Magic-, Poison- and Disease- Resistance by 8%.

perks.name: Fast Reflexes
perks.desc: Time slows down if you are blocking during an enemy's power attack.

perks.name: Battle Mage
perks.desc: Wearing heavy armor doesnt hinder your casting capabilities anymore.

perks.name: Iron Maiden
perks.desc:
For a short period of time you throw all taken melee damage back to your enemies.

Tier I: 5 seconds duration (Cooldown: 110)
Tier II: 9 seconds duration (Cooldown: 100)
Tier III: 13 seconds duration (Cooldown: 90)

perks.name: Steadfast
perks.desc: Time slows down when you are being attacked and your Health falls to less than 15%.

perks.name: Tempest
perks.desc:
This memory unlocks all warrior disciplines for you. You gain the talent "Tempest" which raises your melee weapon damage for a short time.

Tier I: 15% increased weapon damage, 10 seconds duration (Cooldown: 110)
Tier II: 25% increased weapon damage, 12 seconds duration (Cooldown: 105)
Tier III: 35% increased weapon damage, 14 seconds duration (Cooldown: 100)

perks.name: Mercenary
perks.desc:
The memories of the Blade Dancer improve your skill in using one or two one-handed weapons.

Tier I: Increases one-handed damage by 15%
Tier II: Increases one-handed damage by another 14%

perks.name: Relentless Strike
perks.desc: Power attacks with one-handed weapons consume 25% less Stamina.

perks.name: Carnage
perks.desc: Attacks with one-handed axes do additional bleeding damage.

perks.name: Blade Master
perks.desc: Attacks with one-handed swords and daggers have an additional chance of 10% to do a critical hit.

perks.name: Bone Breaker
perks.desc: Attacks with maces penetrate an additional 30% of enemy armor.

perks.name: Qyranian Stance
perks.desc:
Increases attacking and moving speed, but lowers your ability to block. Cannot be stacked with other stances.

Tier I: 8% increased attacking and moving speed, 50% decreased blocking (Cooldown: 4)
Tier II: 12% increased attacking and moving speed, 40% decreased blocking (Cooldown: 4)
Tier III: 16% increased attacking and moving speed, 30% decreased blocking (Cooldown: 4)

perks.name: Critical Hit
perks.desc:
Tier I: When attacking with an one-handed weapon your critical hit damage increases by 25%
Tier II: When attacking with an one-handed weapon your critical hit damage increases by another 20%

perks.name: Bypass Defenses
perks.desc: Power attacks with a one-handed weapon on a blocking enemy deal 30% increased damage.

perks.name: Vortex Blades
perks.desc: Attacks with two one-handed weapons are 10% faster and deal 10% more damage.

perks.name: Sprint Thrust
perks.desc: If you are performing a power attack with a one-handed weapon while sprinting, you deal a critical hit which does 100% increased damage.

perks.name: Calm Hand
perks.desc: If your Stamina is above 70%, your critical hit chance is increased by 10%.

perks.name: Savage Blow
perks.desc: Power attacks with one-handed weapons deal 13% additional damage.

perks.name: Double Vortices
perks.desc:
Tier I: Power attacks with 2 one-handed weapons do 16% more damage.
Tier II: Power attacks with 2 one-handed weapons do another 14% more damage.

perks.name: Blade Dance
perks.desc:
If you hit an enemy 5 times within 15 seconds after using this talent, the last hit does additional damage and staggers that enemy.

Tier I: +35 additional damage (Cooldown: 80)
Tier II: +75 additional damage (Cooldown: 70)
Tier III: +115 additional damage (Cooldown: 60)

perks.name: Stunning Blow
perks.desc:
Applies various bonuses with different one handed weapon types.

Swords: Reduces the damage you take from melee weapon attacks by 15%.
Axes: Attacks versus enemies with low armor deal 20% increased damage.
Maces: Power attacks on a blocking enemy deal 30% increased damage.
Daggers: Critical hits deal 30% increased damage.

perks.name: Focus
perks.desc:
This memory unlocks all mage disciplines for you. You receive the talent "Focus" which lowers the mana costs for spells for a short time.

Tier I: 15% decreased manacost, 20 seconds duration (Cooldown: 110)
Tier II: 17.5% decreased manacost, 30 seconds duration (Cooldown: 105)
Tier III: 20% decreased manacost, 40 seconds duration (Cooldown: 100)

perks.name: Arcane Might
perks.desc:
The memories of the "Elementalist" improve the use of elemental magic.

Tier I: All elemental spells do 12% more damage
Tier II: All elemental spells do another 11% more damage

perks.name: Elemental Apprentice
perks.desc: Reduces the Mana costs of elemental spells of the novice and apprentice level by 35%.

perks.name: Arcane Rage
perks.desc: Shock spells do 18% more damage.

perks.name: Dual Cast
perks.desc: Allows you to cast a more powerful version of an elemental spell by having it equipped in both hands and casting them at the same time.

perks.name: Elemental Frenzy
perks.desc: Fire and frost spells do 15% more damage.

perks.name: Arctic Wind
perks.desc:
Hurls a cone of frost which shortly freezes your enemies. Frozen enemies get a higher damage resistance but there is a small chance of shattering them with a hit. Shock spells, blunt weapons and power attacks increase the chance to shatter them.

Tier I: Freezes the target for 3 seconds, deals 1 damage to health and stamina per second (Cooldown: 100)
Tier II: Freezes the target for 4 seconds, deals 2 damage to health and stamina per second (Cooldown: 90)
Tier II: Freezes the target for 5 seconds, deals 3 damage to health and stamina per second (Cooldown: 80)

perks.name: Elemental Adept
perks.desc: Reduces the Mana costs of elemental spells of the adept level by 35%.

perks.name: Disintegrate
perks.desc: If you hit an enemy with a shock spell and their Health is low, they are instantly disintegrated.

perks.name: Fire and Ice
perks.desc: If you hit an enemy with a frost or a fire spell and their Health is low, said enemy flees if hit by a fire spell and is paralyzed if hit by a frost spell.

perks.name: Rune Master
perks.desc:
Runes gain more range and have reduced Mana cost.

Tier I: 3 times more range, 10% less Mana cost
Tier II: 5 times more range, another 10% less Mana cost

perks.name: Elemental Expert
perks.desc: Reduces the Mana costs of elemental spells of the expert level by 35%.

perks.name: Shock Nova
perks.desc:
Unleashes a wave of electrical energy around you which lets enemies stagger and afterwards summons a lightning which hits them.

Tier I: 10 Shock Damage (Nova), 45 Shock Damage (Lightning) (Cooldown: 100)
Tier II: 20 Shock Damage (Nova), 60 Shock Damage (Lightning) (Cooldown: 100)
Tier III: 30 Shock Damage (Nova), 75 Shock Damage (Lightning) (Cooldown: 100)

perks.name: Electrocution
perks.desc: Fire spells deal 10% increased damage in sunlight, lightning spells deal 20% increased damage during rain and frost spells deal 30% increased damage during snowfall.

perks.name: Impact
perks.desc: Elemental spells can stagger your enemies if dual-casted.

perks.name: Unleashed Might
perks.desc: Reduces the Mana costs of elemental spells of the master level by 35% and every skill point of Elementalism now grants 0.13% increased damage with elemental spells.

perks.name: Assassination
perks.desc:
This memory unlocks all rogue disciplines for you. You receive the talent "Shadow of the Wind" which lets you move more silently for a short period of time and increases your sneak attack damage.

Tier I: 15% more sneak attack damage, 30 seconds duration (Cooldown: 110)
Tier II: 25% more sneak attack damage, 40 seconds duration (Cooldown: 105)
Tier III: 35% more sneak attack damage, 50 seconds duration (Cooldown: 100)

perks.name: Espionage
perks.desc:
The memories of the "Infiltrator" improve your skill in sneaking, your rhetorics and your pickpocketing.

Tier I: The chance to be detected by enemies while sneaking is reduced by 8%. The prices of merchants are 7% better.
Tier II: The chance to be detected by enemies while sneaking is reduced by another 7%. The prices of merchants are another 6% better.

perks.name: Throat Cut
perks.desc: If you attack while you are sneaking your critical hit chance is increased by 10%.

perks.name: Knife Thrust
perks.desc: Sneak attacks with daggers deal 65% increased damage.

perks.name: Assassin
perks.desc: Sneak attacks with one-handed weapons deal 55% increased damage. Does not apply for daggers.

perks.name: Heart Shot
perks.desc: Sneak attacks with bows deal 50% increased damage. Sneak attacks and attacks on mesmerized enemies with dreameater deal 50% increased bonus damage.

perks.name: Flashpowder
perks.desc:
Throw a flash powder which blinds your enemies for a period of time to give you time to hide. Blinded enemies cannot be attacked.

Tier I: 60 feet radius, 8 seconds duration (Cooldown: 110)
Tier II: 90 feet radius, 10 seconds duration (Cooldown: 100)
Tier III: 120 feet radius, 12 seconds duration (Cooldown: 90)

perks.name: Swindler
perks.desc: Pickpocketing pennies is 25% easier.

perks.name: Roll
perks.desc: When you sprint while sneaking you do a forward roll.

perks.name: Fence
perks.desc: Stolen goods now can be sold to every merchant, not only fences.

perks.name: Silent Feet
perks.desc: You move 60% more quietly if you sneak.

perks.name: Bloodlust
perks.desc: Pickpocketing is 10% easier. If you attack while sneaking you penetrate 25% of enemy armor with bows and 35% with melee weapons.

perks.name: Seducer
perks.desc: Unlocks - even if your skill value is small - rhetoric options in the dialogs. You are also receiving 10% better prices from merchants of the opposite gender.

perks.name: Pickpocket
perks.desc: While wearing a melee weapon the chance to be detected by enemies while sneaking is reduced by 12%.

perks.name: Ghostwalk
perks.desc:
Teleports yourself behind a target, you become invisible for a short period of time and your critical hit chance is increased for a short time.

Tier I: 1500 feet distance, critical hit chance increased by 10 percent, 10 seconds invisibility (Cooldown: 50)
Tier II: 2000 feet distance, critical hit chance increased by 25 percent, 15 seconds invisibility (Cooldown: 45)
Tier III: 2500 feet distance, critical hit chance increased by 35 percent, 20 seconds invisibility (Cooldown: 40)

perks.name: Warrior of the Shadows
perks.desc: Sneak attacks now do 30% additional damage.  You also can steal equipped items now.

perks.name: Focus
perks.desc:
This memory unlocks all mage disciplines for you. You receive the talent "Focus" which lowers the mana costs for spells for a short time.

Tier I: 15% decreased manacost, 20 seconds duration (Cooldown: 110)
Tier II: 17.5% decreased manacost, 30 seconds duration (Cooldown: 105)
Tier III: 20% decreased manacost, 40 seconds duration (Cooldown: 100)

perks.name: Concentration
perks.desc:
The memories of the "Sinistrope" teach you the usage of psionics and entropy.

Tier I: Psionic spells stay 15% longer in effect. Entropy spells consume 20% less Health

Tier II: Psionic spells stay another 13% longer in effect. Entropy spells consume another 20% less Health

perks.name: Apprentice of the Dark Arts
perks.desc: Reduces the Mana costs of psionic and entropy spells of the apprentice and novice level by 35%.

perks.name: Mystic Binding
perks.desc: Summoned weapons do 15% more damage and have 75% increased duration.

perks.name: Thought Planting
perks.desc: Psionic spells and talents now can be cast on 25% stronger enemies.

perks.name: Practiced Ritualist
perks.desc: Allows you to cast a more powerful version of a psionic or entropy spell if you equip it in both hands and cast both at the same time.

perks.name: Devour Soul
perks.desc:
Devours the soul of a dead enemy and absorbs a part of their Health, Mana and Stamina.

Tier I: Absorbs 15% of Health (Cooldown: 10)
Tier II: Absorbs 20% of Health and Mana (Cooldown: 10)
Tier III: Absorbs 25% of Health, Stamina and Mana (Cooldown: 10)

perks.name: Mystical Call
perks.desc:
Increases the lifespan of summoned creatures.

Tier I: 50% longer lifespan
Tier II: Another 50% longer lifespan

perks.name: Adept of the Dark Arts
perks.desc: Reduces the Mana costs of psionic and entropy spells of the adept level by 35%.

perks.name: Psionic Veil
perks.desc:
Wraps you in a psionic veil for a short period of time, which makes you invisible. Actions as attacking or activation disrupt the effect.

Tier I:  10 seconds duration (Cooldown: 90)
Tier II:  16 seconds duration (Cooldown: 80) 
Tier III:  22 seconds duration (Cooldown: 70)

perks.name: Bonejudge
perks.desc: All offensive spells are 15% more effective against undead. Reanimated undead "live" 5 times longer.

perks.name: Expert of the Dark Arts
perks.desc: Reduces the Mana costs of psionic and entropy spells of the expert level by 35%.

perks.name: Abyss
perks.desc: Psionic spells also work on undead, ghosts, mechanical constructs and elementals. Enemies who are weakened by psychosis are now also slowed.

perks.name: Quiet Casting
perks.desc: All spells you cast are silent to others.

perks.name: Entropic Blood
perks.desc:
Makes an enemy your slave for a short period of time, which fights for you and deals many times more damage. If the slave dies while this talent is in effect, it explodes in a devastating detonation. Can only be used on enemies who are at most two levels above you.

Tier I: 20 seconds duration, 1.5 times damage of the slave, 30 points of entropic damage upon explosion (Cooldown: 140)
Tier II: 25 seconds duration, 1.75 times damage of the slave, 50 points of entropic damage upon explosion (Cooldown: 140)
Tier III: 30 seconds duration, 2 times damage of the slave, 70 points of entropic damage upon explosion (Cooldown: 140)

perks.name: Master of the Dark Arts
perks.desc: Reduces the Mana costs of psionic and entropy spells of the master level by 35%. Attacking with a bound weapon automatically casts soul trap on the target.

perks.name: Focus
perks.desc:
This memory unlocks all mage disciplines for you. You receive the talent "Focus" which lowers the mana costs for spells for a short time.

Tier I: 15% decreased manacost, 20 seconds duration (Cooldown: 110)
Tier II: 17.5% decreased manacost, 30 seconds duration (Cooldown: 105)
Tier III: 20% decreased manacost, 40 seconds duration (Cooldown: 100)

perks.name: Depth Concentration
perks.desc:
The memories of the "Thaumaturge" enhance your light and mental magic.

Tier I: All mental and light magic spells are 14% more effective
Tier II: All mental and light magic spells are another 12% more effective

perks.name: Mental Apprentice
perks.desc: Reduces the Mana costs of mental and light spells of the novice and apprentice level by 35%.

perks.name: Magical Repulsion
perks.desc: Increases the effect of "Divine Shield" and "Protection from Magic" by 25% while wearing no armor.

perks.name: Arcane Interference
perks.desc: Light Magic spells have 20% increased duration. You receive the ability "Blessing of the Discipline" which allows you to reduce your Arcane Fever by 5% once a day.

perks.name: Dual Casting
perks.desc: Allows you to cast a more powerful version of a mental or light spell if you equip it in both hands and cast both at the same time.

perks.name: Dimensional Rift
perks.desc:
Incapacitate an enemy for a short period of time, absorbs his Mana and Stamina in batches and deals them the drained energy as damage when the effect ends. Can only be used on enemies who are at most two levels above you.

Tier I: 8 seconds duration, drains 15% Mana and Stamina and converts them into damage (Cooldown: 110)
Tier II: 10 seconds duration, drains 20% Mana and Stamina and converts them into damage (Cooldown: 110)
Tier III: 12 seconds duration, drains 25% Mana and Stamina and converts them into damage (Cooldown: 110)

perks.name: Shield Nourishment
perks.desc: If an enemy's spell hits a spell ward from you, you absorb 35% of its mana.

perks.name: Mental Adept
perks.desc: Reduces the Mana costs of mental and light spells of the adept level by 35%.

perks.name: Ambrosia
perks.desc: Healing spells also restore Stamina.

perks.name: Arcane Resistance
perks.desc:
Grants 3 abilities that increase resistance to either frost/shock/fire damage for an unlimited amount of time. Only one can be active at a time.

Tier I: Increases resistance by 15%
Tier II: Increases resistance by another 10%

perks.name: Mental Expert
perks.desc: Reduces the Mana costs of mental and light spells of the expert level by 35%.

perks.name: Death Mage
perks.desc: All offensive spells are 15% more effective against undead and last 25% longer.

perks.name: Counter Spell
perks.desc: Grants a 10% chance to absorb a spell and gain mana equal to spells mana cost.

perks.name: Well of Life
perks.desc:
If you would die while this talent is in effect, your Health instantly regenerates and enemies around you are repulsed.

Tier I: 10 seconds duration, heals you for up to 60% of your total Health (Cooldown: 300)
Tier II: 20 seconds duration, heals you for up to 80% of your total Health (Cooldown: 300)
Tier III: 30 seconds duration, heals all of your Health completely (Cooldown: 300)

perks.name: Mental Master
perks.desc: Reduces the Mana costs of mental and light spells of the master level by 35%. Your Mana regeneration is increased by 8%.

perks.name: Tempest
perks.desc:
This memory unlocks all warrior disciplines for you. You gain the talent "Tempest" which raises your melee weapon damage for a short time.

Tier I: 15% increased weapon damage, 10 seconds duration (Cooldown: 110)
Tier II: 25% increased weapon damage, 12 seconds duration (Cooldown: 105)
Tier III: 35% increased weapon damage, 14 seconds duration (Cooldown: 100)

perks.name: Barbarian
perks.desc:
The memories of the "Vandal" improve your handling of two-handed weapons.

Tier I: Two-handed weapons do 15% more damage
Tier II: Two-handed weapons do another 14% more damage

perks.name: Bloodthirst
perks.desc:
Raises your attack speed with two-handed weapons.

Tier I:  10% faster attacking speed
Tier II:  Another 9% faster attacking speed

perks.name: Amputator
perks.desc: Attacks with battleaxes do more additional bleed damage.

perks.name: Deep Wounds
perks.desc: Attacks with greatswords have an additional chance of 10% to do a critical hit.

perks.name: Brute
perks.desc: Attacks with warhammers penetrate an additional 30% of enemy armor.

perks.name: Skaraggian Stance
perks.desc:
Increases damage and power of your blows and shield bashes, but also the damage you take yourself.

Tier I: 15% more damage, 50% more power, 25% less damage resistance (Cooldown: 4)
Tier II: 25% more damage, 100% more power, 22.5% less damage resistance (Cooldown: 4)
Tier III: 35% more damage, 150% more power, 20% less damage resistance (Cooldown: 4)

perks.name: Fury-Driven
perks.desc: Grants you a steady Health regeneration while you are fighting with a two-handed weapon.

perks.name: Hawk Thrust
perks.desc: If you are performing a power attack with a two-handed weapon while sprinting, you deal a critical hit which does 100% increased damage.

perks.name: Unwavering
perks.desc: Backwards power attacks with two-handed weapons knock the target back.

perks.name: Warrior Posture
perks.desc:
Reduces the Stamina cost of power attacks.

Tier I: 18% cost reduction
Tier II: Another 15% cost reduction

perks.name: Precise Blow
perks.desc: You take 25% less physical damage from enemy attacks while power attacking.

perks.name: Merciless
perks.desc: Power attacks with two-handed weapons deal 13% additional damage.

perks.name: Sweeping Blow
perks.desc: As long as your health is 50% or less, blocking with two-handed weapons is 25% more effective.

perks.name: Archaic Might
perks.desc:
Discharges your power in a shockwave which repulses enemies and does high damage to them. Staggered enemies are taking additional damage.

Tier I: Deals 40 points of damage, staggered enemies take additional 30 points (Cooldown: 100)
Tier II: Deals 50 points of damage, staggered enemies take additional 50 points (Cooldown: 100)
Tier III: Deals 60 points of damage, staggered enemies take additional 70 points (Cooldown: 100)

perks.name: Brute Blow
perks.desc: Blocking enemies now take 40% more damage from your attacks with two-handed weapons. Attacks with two-handed weapons ignore 10% of the enemy armor rating.

perks.name: Assassination
perks.desc:
This memory unlocks all rogue disciplines for you. You receive the talent "Shadow of the Wind" which lets you move more silently for a short period of time and increases your sneak attack damage.

Tier I: 15% more sneak attack damage, 30 seconds duration (Cooldown: 110)
Tier II: 25% more sneak attack damage, 40 seconds duration (Cooldown: 105)
Tier III: 35% more sneak attack damage, 50 seconds duration (Cooldown: 100)

perks.name: Strong Bowstring
perks.desc:
The memories of the "Trickster" combine the effective use of a bow with lockpicking.

Tier I: Bows do 15% more damage
Tier II: Bows do another 14% more damage

perks.name: Skilled Hands
perks.desc: Apprentice locks are easier to pick and your armor rating increases by 15% while you have a bow equipped.

perks.name: Eagle Eye
perks.desc: Pressing Block while aiming will zoom in your view.

perks.name: Fire Arrow
perks.desc:
Grants you a handful of fire arrows, which explode upon impact and do fire damage.

Tier I: 2 arrows, do 4.5 points of fire damage per second, 10 seconds duration (Cooldown: 110)
Tier II: 3 arrows, do 5 points of fire damage per second, 14 seconds duration (Cooldown: 110)
Tier III: 4 arrows, do 5.5 points of fire damage per second, 18 seconds duration (Cooldown: 110)

perks.name: Concentration
perks.desc: Bows do 18% more damage as long as your Stamina is above 80%.

perks.name: Thief Apprentice
perks.desc: You can pick adept locks now and locks with adept difficulty or lower are easier to pick. Your stamina regeneration is increased by 15% while you have a bow equipped.

perks.name: Rapid Shot
perks.desc: You can draw a bow 20% faster.

perks.name: Ranger
perks.desc: You are able to move faster with a drawn bow.

perks.name: Replica
perks.desc: Automatically gives you a copy of a picked lock's key.

perks.name: Expert Locksmith
perks.desc: You can pick expert locks now and locks with expert difficulty or lower are easier to pick. Bows penetrate 25% of enemy armor and do 10% increased damage to creatures with impenetrable armor.

perks.name: Fatal Shot
perks.desc:
Increases your critical hit chance with bows.

Tier I: Increases critical hit chance by 10%
Tier II: Increases critical hit chance by another 5% and increases critcal hit damage by 20%

perks.name: Master with the Bowstring
perks.desc: Zooming in with a bow now costs half as much Stamina than before and slows down time by 50%. All arrows do 1 more point of damage.

perks.name: Eye of the Storm
perks.desc:
Stops time for your enemies and your surroundings for a short period of time. Only works if your equipped weapon is a bow.

Tier I: 7 seconds duration (Cooldown: 140)
Tier II: 9 seconds duration (Cooldown: 140)
Tier III: 11 seconds duration (Cooldown: 140)

perks.name: Shadow Player
perks.desc: While you are in the dark you deal 15% more sneak attack damage with bows and your ability to sneak is improved by 15%.

perks.name: Master Thief
perks.desc: Lockpicking is easier and you can pick master locks. Additionally your arrows often stagger opponents (excluding the largest ones)

perks.name: Assassination
perks.desc:
This memory unlocks all rogue disciplines for you. You receive the talent "Shadow of the Wind" which lets you move more silently for a short period of time and increases your sneak attack damage.

Tier I: 15% more sneak attack damage, 30 seconds duration (Cooldown: 110)
Tier II: 25% more sneak attack damage, 40 seconds duration (Cooldown: 105)
Tier III: 35% more sneak attack damage, 50 seconds duration (Cooldown: 100)

perks.name: Suitable Armor
perks.desc:
The memories of the "Vagrant" teach you in the usage of poisons, potions and light armor.

Tier I: Light armor is 25% more effective
Tier II: Light armor is another 23% more effective

perks.name: Ointment Lore
perks.desc:
All self made potions are more effective from now on.

Tier I: 17% more effective
Tier II: Another 15% more effective

perks.name: Poison Cook
perks.desc: Brewed poisons are 30% more effective. Chymica are 15% more effective.

perks.name: Wind Walker
perks.desc: If you are not wearing heavy armor, your Stamina regeneration is increased by 30% and enemies can no longer stagger you while sprinting.

perks.name: Sensitive Tongue
perks.desc: Consuming an ingredient reveals all of their alchemy effects from now on.

perks.name: Snake Tongue Oil
perks.desc:
Throw a bottle that creates a glibbery oil puddle upon impact which causes enemies to slip and slows them. The oil puddle can be set on fire.

Tier I: Slows enemies by 5%, 15 fire damage per second (Cooldown: 120)
Tier II: Slows enemies by 25%, 20 fire damage per second (Cooldown: 110)
Tier III: Slows enemies by 45%, 25 fire damage per second (Cooldown: 100)

perks.name: Experimenter
perks.desc: Poison which is applied to your weapons stays in effect twice as long. You can also now create Ambrosia at spectralizing table.

perks.name: Lightweight
perks.desc: From now on, a light armor does not weigh anything and does not slow you down when you wear it.

perks.name: Bigger Pockets
perks.desc: Increases your carrying capacity by 50.

perks.name: Perfect Fit
perks.desc: If you are not wearing heavy armor, you receive an armor bonus of 30%.

perks.name: Master Brewer
perks.desc: All self-brewed potions and poisons are 20% more effective from now on.

perks.name: Purity
perks.desc: All negative effects of self-brewed potions and all positive effects of self-brewed poisons are removed.

perks.name: Snakeblood
perks.desc: Your poison resistance is increased by 50%. A poison resistance of 50% or more will protect you from paralyze and slow effects caused by poisons.

perks.name: Starling Spider
perks.desc:
Throw a mechanical spider which attracts the attention of enemies at its destination. If the enemies are close enough - or if you use the talent again - the spider explodes, which paralyzes enemies for a short period of time and weakens them with a neurotoxin.

Tier I: 150 feet attention radius, 10 seconds poisoned, 25% more damage to poisoned enemies (Cooldown: 100)
Tier II: 200 feet attention radius, 15 seconds poisoned, 30% more damage to poisoned enemies (Cooldown: 95)
Tier III: 250 feet attention radius, 20 seconds poisoned, 35% more damage to poisoned enemies (Cooldown: 90)

perks.name: High Dexterity
perks.desc: If you are not wearing heavy armor, there is a chance of 15% that the damage of a melee attack is completely intercepted.

perks.name: Net of Souls
perks.desc:
The memories of the Phasmalist allow you to construct ghostly companions for you from the souls of dead people by using your knowledge in enchanting.

The talent 'Net of Souls' allows you to see and collect souls.

Tier I: Allows you to see souls with the level 1 and 2 for 40 seconds. (Cooldown: 60)
Tier II: Allows you to see souls with the level 1 to 4 for 50 seconds. (Cooldown: 60)
Tier III: Allows you to see souls with the level 1 to 5 for 60 seconds. (Cooldown: 60)

perks.name: Soul Smith - Novice
perks.desc: You can make talismans from souls with the rank I at phasmalist workbenches.

perks.name: Summon Apparition
perks.desc:
You can summon the apparition bound to your equipped amulet. If it dies or leaves the reality due other reasons you are getting Arcane Fever proportionally to the Health the apparition lost since it was summoned.

Tier I: Base increase of Arcane Fever: 8%.
Tier II: Base increase of Arcane Fever: 6%.
Tier III: Base increase of Arcane Fever: 4%.

perks.name: Arcane Smith
perks.desc: You can improve enchanted weapons and armor.

perks.name: Wise Enchanter
perks.desc:
Your enchantments are getting stronger.

Tier I: Enchantments are 14% stronger.
Tier II: Enchantments are an additional 12% stronger.
Tier III: Enchantments are an additional 10% stronger.

perks.name: Arcane Disassembling
perks.desc: You can dismantle enchanted weapons and armors.

perks.name: Soul Smith - Apprentice
perks.desc: You can make talismans from souls with the rank II at phasmalist workbenches.

perks.name: Focus - Deviousness
perks.desc:
Apparitions do more damage with a bow and have a higher chance for critical hits

Tier I: The chance for critical hits is increased by 10% and the marksmanship skill of the apparition is increased by 10 points.
Tier II: The chance for critical hits is increased by 18% and the marksmanship skill of the apparition is increased 18 points.
Tier III: The chance for critical hits is increased by 26% and the marksmanship skill of the apparition is increased by 26 points.

perks.name: Focus - Shaman
perks.desc:
Your apparitions can use the arcane arts better.

- Tier I: Apparitions have 40 points more Mana and do 8% more damage with elemental spells
- Tier II: Apparitions have 70 points more Mana and do 15% more damage with elemental spells
- Tier III: Apparitions have 100 points more Mana and do 22% more damage with elemental spells

perks.name: Focus - Violence
perks.desc:
Melee weapon and armor skill of your apparitions is strengthened

Tier I: Melee weapon and armor skill values are increased by 10 points.
Tier II: Melee weapon and armor skill values are increased by 18 points.
Tier III: Melee weapon and armor skill values are increased by 26 points.

perks.name: Soul Smith - Adept
perks.desc: You can make talismans from souls with the rank III at phasmalist workbenches.

perks.name: Soul Smith - Expert
perks.desc: You can make talismans from souls with the rank IV at phasmalist workbenches.

perks.name: Essence Splitting
perks.desc: Health, Mana and Stamina of the apparition now aren't dependent on your own corresponding attributes anymore but only on the strongest value of your attributes.

perks.name: Phasmalic Veil
perks.desc: You can take apparitions into cities.

perks.name: Transmutation
perks.desc:
You can receive electroplasm from killed undead enemies and soul gems from normal corpses.

Tier I: 300 seconds cooldown
Tier II: 150 seconds cooldown
Tier III: 5 seconds cooldown

perks.name: Soul Smith - Master
perks.desc: You can make talismans from souls with the rank V at phasmalist workbenches.

perks.name: Wolf Blood
perks.desc:
This memory allows you to use wolf blood potions and chymica as a means to transform into a werewolf. In this tier the duration of transformation is limited to at most 90 seconds.

The strength of the wolf form is calculated from many factors, first of all your Alchemy level and your Stamina. Individual aspects of a transformation can be enhanced with "Chymica".

perks.name: Portable Laboratory
perks.desc:
Allows you to use a portable alchemy laboratory on your travels.

Tier I: The potions brewed in the portable laboratory are equal to regular ones. (Cooldown: 160)
Tier II: The potions brewed in the portable laboratory are 10 percent more effective than regular ones. (Cooldown: 80)
Tier III: The potions brewed in the portable laboratory are 20 percent more effective than regular ones. (Cooldown: 3)

perks.name: Grey Alchemist
perks.desc:
Wolf Blood and Chymica can now:

Tier I: have a duration of up to 120 seconds.
Tier II: have a duration of up to 180 seconds.
Tier III: have an unlimited duration.

perks.name: Fast Metabolism
perks.desc:
Reduces the worsening of your Arcane Fever upon drinking a wolf blood potion.

Tier I: 17% less Arcane Fever
Tier II: 33% less Arcane Fever

perks.name: Mangle
perks.desc: Unlocks a devastating claw attack which is activated by attacking during sprinting and which knocks smaller enemies from their feet.

perks.name: Careful Harvest
perks.desc: Doubles the harvest of plants with a chance of 40%.

perks.name: Thick Hide
perks.desc:
Increases your elemental resistances in wolf form. 

Tier I: 15% frost and shock resistance in wolf form
Tier II: 30% frost and shock resistance in wolf form

perks.name: Instinct
perks.desc: Allows you to perceive enemies over great distances or through walls.

perks.name: Stalk
perks.desc:
In wolf form sneaking is more effective and quicker. Independent of "Silent Hunt".

Tier I: Sneak 10% better and your movement speed during sneaking is 5% higher
Tier II: Sneak 20% better and your movement speed during sneaking is 10% higher
Tier III: Sneak 30% better and your movement speed during sneaking is 20% higher

perks.name: Call of the Hunt
perks.desc:
Emits a terrifying howl which damages nearby enemies. Can only be used in wolf form.

Tier I: Nearby enemies take 40 damage. (Cooldown: 100)
Tier II: Nearby enemies take 60 damage. Weak enemies flee. (Cooldown: 100)
Tier III: Nearby enemies take 80 damage and stagger. Weak enemies flee. (Cooldown: 100)

perks.name: Dark Alchemist
perks.desc:
Increases the effects of wolf blood and chymica:

Tier I: Wolf blood potions now have 25% longer durations and chymica are 15% stronger.
Tier II: Wolf blood potions now have 50% longer durations and chymica are 30% stronger.

perks.name: Detoxification
perks.desc:
Emit all of your currently active chymica in a toxic cloud which damages enemies. The effect and strength of the poison depends on the used chymica.

Tier I: Ends the effect of all active chymica. (Cooldown: 110)
Tier II: Active chymica have a chance of 50% to stay activated. (Cooldown: 100)
Tier III: Active chymica are no longer consumed. (Cooldown: 90)

perks.name: Mimicry
perks.desc: Your wolf form is now concealed for humans. You can enter villages and cities without transforming back.

perks.name: Silent Hunt
perks.desc: Moving in sneak mode as a werewolf won't make any sounds anymore.

perks.name: Aether Blood
perks.desc: Instead of your Stamina now either your Stamina OR your Mana affects your strength in wolf form, depending on which attribute is higher.

perks.name: Black Alchemist
perks.desc: Wolf Blood potions have a 100% longer duration.
